workflows.title: Bugfix
workflows.description: Fix a reported bug, from root cause and a failing test to a reviewed pull request.

workflows.title: Feature
workflows.description: Build a new capability end to end, from the plan card to a reviewed pull request.

workflows.title: Hotfix
workflows.description: Fix a high-risk or production-affecting bug with the diagnosis accepted first, a minimal change and a mandatory review.

workflows.title: Project health
workflows.description: Weekly gardener run that cross-checks the tracker, pull requests, milestones, knowledge and handoffs and produces one health-report issue.

workflows.title: QA
workflows.description: Verify a built change or a deployed build against what was intended, with browser checks and a SHIP or DO NOT SHIP verdict. Fixes are not made here.

workflows.title: Release
workflows.description: Take merged work to a release - inventory since the last tag, release notes and store copy from changelog fragments, the cut behind the owner's approval, then close the milestone, record lessons and update the roadmap.

workflows.title: Research
workflows.description: Research a question before building - what already exists in the repository, registries and on GitHub, what to adopt, extend or build - and report with sources.

workflows.title: Roadmap review
workflows.description: Review the roadmap held in tracker milestones (one GitHub Project per multi-repo product) and propose what to cut, move or add.

workflows.title: Triage
workflows.description: Take new issues from needs-triage to ready-for-agent or ready-for-human, with a type, a size, a risk and a blocked-by line.
